configuration.accessibility: Mean marginal unpaired probability at each matched site's bases, summed across overlapping sites, normalized per 100 input nucleotides; not joint accessibility
configuration.branchpoint_model: excluded: short degenerate motif without full intron/donor context would not identify a functional branchpoint
configuration.motif_interpretation: Curated consensus proxies, not RBP-specific measured binding or calibrated occupancy; UG repeat length 3 is an engineering summary, not a binding threshold
configuration.outcome_exclusion: No observations are deleted by this feature extraction; treatment/flag strategy requires prospective inner-only selection
configuration.processing_interpretation: Local motif-based nuisance summaries only; not splice/PAS probabilities; absent full reporter architecture precludes a validated splice-site inference claim

feature_order: four motif density deltas, followed by four site-marginal exposure density deltas
